snippet.title: EA SPORTS FC 26 Official Launch Trailer | The Club is Yours
snippet.description:
The Club is Yours. Play EA SPORTS FC™ 26 from September 19 with Ultimate Edition: https://x.ea.com/86220

Play your way in EA SPORTS FC™ 26 with an overhauled gameplay experience powered by community feedback, Manager Live Challenges that bring fresh scenarios to the new season, and Archetypes inspired by greats of the game. https://x.ea.com/86241

Subscribe to see more from EA SPORTS FC™: http://bit.ly/pzw4VD
#EASPORTSFC #FC26
